turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Hi, this is Nimbus Broadband support. Am I speaking with the account holder?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Hi Aditya. The last four digits of your registered mobile, please?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thanks, verified. How can I help?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: My speed is bad for gaming. Downloads take forever and my ping is terrible in the evening.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Let me check. There's no outage in your area. Could you run a speed test in the Nimbus app?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Your current plan is 50 Mbps, so you're getting close to the full plan speed. The connection itself looks healthy. The slowness you're feeling is likely the plan's limit for heavy downloads.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: So I need a bigger plan? How much is the 200 one? Can you give me a discount since I've been with you four years?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I'm not able to quote prices or discounts myself, but our sales team can go through the plans and any offers with you. Shall I transfer you now?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Sure. Summary for the sales team: connection is healthy at 48 of 50 Mbps, you want a faster plan for gaming. Transferring you now. Thanks for being with us, Aditya.
